entries.name: SLOOP 3
entries.use: its web editor (web/editor.html) is bundled unchanged and shown on the Editor page; the application area of 3.4.0 (sloop3-3.4.0.area, from the release, checksum pinned) is bundled for a later offline install; the installer page is not bundled

entries.name: m-bootloader, M-Flasher
entries.use: both bundled unchanged from their releases (fm1-uboot.boot 2.4; M-Flasher 0.12.1 for aarch64 and x86_64 in the packages), checksums pinned and checked before every use; the app runs M-Flasher's read-only commands and reads an FM-1 in m-bootloader's MIDI MODE as its specification describes (Recovery › Tools)
